description: GraphQL depth and static complexity score — Parses a GraphQL document (query, mutation or subscription) per the June 2018 spec and returns depth, field count, alias count, fragment list, cycle detection and a static complexity score. Complexity uses the common 'Σ field-score × list-multiplier' model: a listFields config maps parent-type + field-name to either a constant multiplier or a field argument name to read (e.g. 'first', 'limit'), wi

defaultListMultiplier.description: Fallback multiplier for list fields not declared in listFields. Default 10.

listFields.description: Per-type field multiplier config. See description for shape.

maxComplexity.description: Fail if complexity exceeds this. Default 1000.

maxDepth.description: Fail if depth exceeds this. Default 15.

operationName.description: Pick this operation; defaults to the first.

variables.description: Variable values, used only to resolve list-argument multipliers like first: $first.

name: graphql-cost
